en.bdb: Wicked persons remain unhappy even in happiness

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣ ਵਣ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਵੁਠੇ ਸੁਕੈ ਅਕੁ ਜਵਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: saavan van hareeaavale vuThe sukai ak javaahaa|

en.bdb: In the month of Sayan forests go green but akk, a wild plant of sandy region, and /avail, the camel thorn, wither.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਵਣਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀਐ ਅਪਤ ਕਰੀਰ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਉਸਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: chet vanasapat mauleeaai apat kareer na karai usaahaa|

en.bdb: In the month of Chaitr, the vegetation blooms but leafless kart (a wild caper) remains totally uninspired.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੰਦੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਭ ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਫਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਵਿਸਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: sufal fala(n)dhe birakh sabh si(n)mal afal rahai avisaahaa|

en.bdb: All the trees become full of fruits but the silk cotton tree remains devoid of fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਨਣ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਵਾਂਸ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ਨ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)nan vaas vanaasapat vaa(n)s nivaas na ubhe saahaa|

en.bdb: The whole vegetation is made fragrant by sandal wood but bamboo gets no impact of it and goes on sobbing and sighing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਖੁ ਸਮੁੰਦਹੁ ਸਖਣਾ ਦੁਖਿਆਰਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੇ ਧਾਹਾਂ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)kh samu(n)dhahu sakhanaa dhukhiaaraa rovai dhe dhaahaa(n)|

en.bdb: Even being in the ocean, the conch remains empty and cries bitterly when blown.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਗੰਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਝੀਗੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਇ ਭਿਛਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: bagul samaadhee ga(n)g vich jheegai chun chun khai bhichhaahaa|

en.bdb: The crane even looking to be meditating upon the banks of Ganges, like a beggar picks up the fish and eats them up.
Separation from good company brings noose for the individual.
